comment.pt: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Diversos</title><remarkFreeText><translation>A alteração 7 foi anulada por razões técnicas.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>As alterações 1, 3 e 4 foram retiradas.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ro: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Diverse</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendamentul 7 a fost anulat din motive tehnice.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendamentele 1, 3 și 4 au fost retrase.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.en: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Miscellaneous</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendment 7 had been cancelled for technical reasons.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendments 1, 3 and 4 had been withdrawn.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lt: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Įvairūs</title><remarkFreeText><translation>7 pakeitimas buvo panaikintas dėl techninių priežasčių.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>1, 3 ir 4 pakeitimai buvo atšaukti.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sl: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Razno</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Predlog spremembe 7 je bil razveljavljen zaradi tehničnih razlogov.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Predlogi sprememb 1, 3 in 4 so bili umaknjeni.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.da: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Diverse</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Ændringsforslag 7a blev annulleret af tekniske årsager.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Ændringsforslag 1, 3 og 4 blev trukket tilbage.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.fr: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Divers</title><remarkFreeText><translation>L'amendement 7 a été annulé pour des raisons techniques.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Les amendements 1, 3, 4 ont été retirés.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ga: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Aon ghnó eile</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Rinneadh Leasú 7 a chealú ar chúiseanna teicniúla.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Rinneadh Leasuithe 1, 3 agus 4 a tharraingt siar.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.es: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Varios</title><remarkFreeText><translation>La enmienda 7 ha sido anulada por razones técnicas.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Las enmiendas 1, 3 y 4 han sido retiradas.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.bg: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Разни</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Изменение 7 беше анулирано по технически причини.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Изменения 1, 3 и 4 бяха оттеглени.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lv: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Dažādi</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Grozījums Nr. 7 bija atcelts tehnisku iemeslu dēļ.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Grozījumi Nr. 1, 3 un 4 bija atsaukti.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sk: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Iné</title><remarkFreeText><translation>PN 7 bol z technických dôvodov zrušený.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>PN 1, 3 a 4 boli stiahnuté.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.de: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Verschiedenes</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Änderungsantrag 7 wurde aus technischen Gründen annulliert.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Die Änderungsanträge 1, 3 und 4 wurden zurückgezogen.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.el: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Διάφορα</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Η τροπολογία 7 ακυρώθηκε για τεχνικούς λόγους.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Οι τροπολογίες 1, 3 και 4 αποσύρθηκαν.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.it: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Varie</title><remarkFreeText><translation>L'emendamento 7 è stato annullato per ragioni tecniche.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Gli emendamenti 1, 3 e 4 sono stati ritirati.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.hr: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Razno</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amandman 7. poništen je zbog tehničkih razloga.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Amandmani 1, 3 i 4 povučeni su.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.pl: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Różne</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Poprawka 7 została anulowana z powodów technicznych.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Poprawki 1, 3 i 4 zostały wycofane.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.nl: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Diversen</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendement 7 is om technische redenen geannuleerd.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>De amendementen 1, 3 en 4 zijn ingetrokken.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.cs: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Různé</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Pozměňovací návrh 7 byl zrušen z technických důvodů.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Pozměňovací návrhy 1, 3, 4 byly staženy.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
